description: Four couples, and the laugh alone

participation.context: Counted the couples and left the blank.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: a page that still ends on a laugh

story.body: You wrote the four couples and the one colour, and you left the page where the names fail. You did not write a follower.

relations.note: a page that still ends on a laugh

topics: a laugh with nothing after it

title: Counted four couples and stopped on the laugh

participation.context: Spoke the memo, laughed once without sound, and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named as the man who will object. Not present.
participation.name: John Heminges

relations.note: an objection he has not heard yet
relations.quote: Heminges will say it's no ending.

story.body: You said the laughing pageant could be forgotten by Lent, then brought a man in black from her father's court and shortened him three times. You set the marriage off by a twelvemonth. You named Heminges's objection and kept the ending anyway. The frost on the pump cut in, and you stopped.

relations.note: an objection he has not heard yet
relations.quote: Heminges will say it's no ending.

title: Found the messenger and stopped on a doorstep

participation.context: Wrote the entrance and left the blank.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Below. Heard a murmur, if she heard anything. Not spoken to.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

relations.note: a floor between, and only a murmur

story.body: You put the messenger in black on the page and stopped where he would have spoken. The rest of his line is empty. You walked the six steps, and you did not go down to explain it.

relations.note: a floor between, and only a murmur
